definition: [ משֶׁ֫כֶת ] noun feminine cord ; — only plural construct משְׁכוֺת כְּסִיל Job 38:31 the cords of Orion , i.e. probably those by which (according to some legend) he is dragged along in the sky (compare Di ). מִשְׁכָּב see שׁכב . מִשְׁכָּן see שׁכן .
